timing: Before any actual-data candidate scoring or truth evaluation
window_convention: All evaluated windows are half-open [start,end). All8801 state rows are extracted, including terminal44s; it is excluded from held-interval metrics.
duration_reporting: Report row counts and5ms sampled disagreement-equivalent seconds, not proven continuous wrong-contact durations.
tie_convention: Exactly equal maximum positive loads/scores are ties; tie-broken raw rank remains explicitly tied, cannot be confident. Missing/zero baseline total or tied maximum is unknown.
source_api_mapping: Campaign source maps the sealed protocol's nested candidate_search/scales/confidence fields to helper kwargs. There is no independent rank_options override or post-result tuning.
secondary_datasets: No additional I46 or P datasets are part of this initial execution. Clock limitations are handled by documented convention and prespecified stable-truth subset, without new physics.
